name: Ember
long_description:
Ember is rebuilding the back office of healthcare finance.

Behind every provider sits a mountain of administrative complexity, and that drag lands where it matters most: cost, capacity, and care. Ember clears it with intelligent automation, so provider groups can spend their time on patients, not paperwork.

We're reimagining how revenue moves through healthcare, and how lean teams scale without trading away quality. Our platform drops into existing provider workflows, takes the manual work off their plate, and gives leaders real-time visibility into financial and operational performance.

We're growing fast, and we're hiring sharp, resourceful people who want to build. Right now, that starts with you.
one_liner: AI RCM. Increase net revenue by 16%.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Charlene is the CEO and co-founder of Ember. Previously a product manager on Healthcare AI at Google, she collaborated with Elevance Health to develop remote patient monitoring solutions. Charlene led the launch of sleep-sensing technology on Google Nest’s smart displays, improving the sleep quality of millions of users. Her research has been featured in Radiology and NEJM Catalyst. She holds a degree in Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, and Economics from Brown University.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Warren is the co-founder of Ember. In the past, he did explainable AI research at MIT CSAIL and medical AI research with NVIDIA at hospitals in Taiwan. Warren holds a BS in EECS/Physics and MEng in EECS from MIT. He was a gold medalist at the 50th International Physics Olympiad.

launches.title: Ember Copilot - Instant ICD-10 Code Search
launches.tagline: We help doctors instantly find the right medical codes to bill.
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We’re [Charlene](https://linkedin.com/in/hsinleiwang) and [Warren](https://linkedin.com/in/warrenweinwang/), co-founders of [Ember Copilot](https://www.embercopilot.ai/).

# **TL;DR**

Ember Copilot helps surgery centers automate medical scribing, coding, and billing. Our autonomous coding solution achieves **98% accuracy** and reduces **denials by 55%.**

<https://youtu.be/jRSdwId10No> 

# **Why does medical coding matter?**

Medical coding determines how much healthcare providers get paid for their services. Without accurate coding, claims are denied, delaying or preventing payments for the work providers do.

# ​​**Why are we building autonomous medical coding?**

Today, many doctors still handle coding themselves, often relying on Google searches to navigate complex rules they weren't trained for. For example, as one billing manager shared:

"_We've got doctors that like to unbundle stuff, and not understanding that it's bundled, then you can't bill them separately_." 

This challenge becomes even more significant in surgical procedures, where multiple codes, complex bundling rules, and specific documentation requirements create confusion.

Some practices outsource coding and billing, but this approach isn’t perfect either. Coders aren’t in the exam room and often lack the full context of the patient encounter. This leads to time-consuming back-and-forth clarifications with physicians, delaying claims and introducing inaccuracies.

# **Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87221&key=user_uploads/198052/642df116-7838-4e4b-92c6-a61052dd417b)

To help providers get started, we've made [ICD10codes.ai](http://ICD10codes.ai) free for everyone to use. Simply insert a diagnosis or your full clinical note to get the most relevant ICD-10 code back. This works for both diagnoses and procedures.

Our complete system goes further: 

* Handles ICD-10, CPT, and DRG while integrating directly with EHRs like EPIC. 
* Flags bundling issues, suggests appropriate modifiers, and validates documentation against payer requirements in real time.

 

This is especially valuable for surgical coding where providers deal with complex bundling rules and specific documentation requirements from payers like UnitedHealthcare’s enhanced requirements.

By combining autonomous coding with our scribing product, Ember Copilot helps providers identify missing documentation and meet requirements while the patient is still in the room. It’s like having a coding expert present at all times—without any overhead or delays.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87221&key=user_uploads/198052/d7e175a7-d2fd-4c32-9021-4f14323a624a)

# **Ask**

Know a doctor who takes insurance? Connect us! We’re looking to help:

* Physician offices
* Ambulatory surgery centers
* Government agencies

We’d love for them to try Ember Copilot on past claims and see the results directly.

👉 Try it for free at [ICD10codes.ai](http://ICD10codes.ai) or email us at [**founders@embercopilot.ai**](mailto:founders@embercopilot.ai)

Thank you!

Charlene & Warren

launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84770&key=user_uploads/198052/87f670f9-9471-494d-8b31-7c2ade36436f)

Hey everyone! We’re [Charlene](https://linkedin.com/in/hsinleiwang) and [Warren](https://linkedin.com/in/warrenweinwang/), co-founders of [Ember Copilot](https://www.embercopilot.ai/).

# **TL;DR**

We help surgeons automate medical scribing, patient intake, insurance letters, and more, all directly integrated within their EHR. We’ve helped our early customers bring in over $60,000/mo.

<https://youtu.be/RUkosYD-FLQ>

# **Problem**

There are many AI scribes, but they’re mostly built for outpatient settings. Surgeons work in fast-paced, high-stress environments and rely heavily on dictation, templates, and human scribes. AI makes too many mistakes, and surgeons don’t have the time to fix those inaccuracies.

# **Solution: A medical assistant designed for surgeons**

1. **Quality:** By grounding the documentation in medical history and clinical consultations, we ensure precise SOAP and procedure notes.
2. **Revenue Impact:** Our AI assistant reviews billing history and drafts letters of medical necessity, helping early customers generate over $60,000 per month in additional revenue.
3. **Customization:** We customize workflows to fit subspecialties and fully integrate with general, orthopedic, and other types of surgery.

# **Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84770&key=user_uploads/198052/83775b8f-0745-4dca-a203-494237d0fd2e)

We’ve built healthcare AI products for hospitals and insurers during our time at Google, NVIDIA, and MIT, so we know how to integrate tech into clinical workflows.

This mission is personal for us—our parents are in healthcare, and we’ve seen firsthand how much time gets wasted on paperwork. Our goal is to take that burden off providers so they can focus on patient care and reclaim some time for themselves.

# **🙏 Ask: Share this post**

Do you know anyone connected with **clinics**, **surgery centers**, **telehealth platforms**, **MSOs**, or **PE firms involved in medical roll-ups**?

We’d love to connect via DM or email at [founders@embercopilot.ai](mailto:founders@embercopilot.ai).

Thank you!

Charlene & Warren
